definitions.full: H3898. lacham I. [ לָחַם ] 171 verb fight, do battle (Late Hebrew Hithpa`el; ואלתחם MI 11.15.19 perhaps = order the battle , compare Nö ZMG xl. 1886, 721 ; Arabic fit close together , so Late Hebrew לחם Pi`el, Syriac Pa`el unite , fit also threaten ; Gerber Verb. Denom. 59 thinks verb in Hebrew denominative from מִלְחָמָה battle-line , but dubious); — Qal (poetry) only Imperative masculine singular and Participle active — fight, do battle with, rare, only Psalms, apparently later usage: — אֶתלֹֿחֲמָ֑י לְחַם Psa 35:1 do battle with those battling with me (dubious whether את is accusative sign compare preposition with , compare Ol; || אֶתיְֿרִיבַי רִיבָה ); לִי לֹחֲמִים 56:3 doing battle against me ; לֹחֵם 56:2 as substantive fighter. Niph`al 167 Perfect נִלְחַם Judg 9:17 +, וְנִלְחַמְתָּ֫ 11:8 ; 1Sam 15:18 , וְנִלְחַמְנוּ Deut 1:41 consecutive, etc.; Imperfect יִלָּהֵם Exod 14:14 ; Deut 1:30 ; לָ֑נוּ יִלָּ֫חֶם Neh 4:14 , וַיִּלָּ֫חֶם Exod 17:8 19t.; 3 feminine singular תִּלָּחֵם Zech 14:14 ; 3 masculine plural תִּיִּלָּֽחֲמוּ Judg 1:5 13 t.; suffix וַיִּלָּֽחֲמוּנִי Psa 109:3 ; 2 masculine plural תִּלָּֽחֲמוּ 1Kin 22:31 4 t.; תִּלָּֽחֲמוּן 12:24 .; etc.; Imperative הִלָּחֵם Exod 17:9 ; 1Sam 18:17 ; בּוֺ הִלָּ֫חֶם Judg 9:38 ; plural הִלָּֽחֲמוּ 2Kin 10:3 ; Neh 4:8 ; Infinitive absolute נִלְחֹם Judg 11:25 ; construct הִלָּחֵם 1:9 35 t.; בּוֺ הִלָּ֫חֶם etc., Num 22:11 6 t.; suffix הִלָּחֲמוֺ 2Kin 8:29 3 t.; Participle נִלְחָם Exod 14:24 10 t.; plural נִלְחָמִים Josh 10:25 10 t. II. [ לָחַם ] verb use as food, eat , poetic (so Thes Buhl, compare Frä 30 Guidi Della Sede 33 ; this would explain different between לֶחֶם and ; yet verb rare and chiefly late); — Qal Perfect 3plural לָֽחֲמוּ Prov 4:17 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular תִּלְחַם 23:6 , 1 singular אֶלְחַם Psa 141:4 ; Imperative masculine plural לַחֲמוּ Prov 9:5 ; Infinitive construct לְחוֺם 23:1 ; Passive participle plural construct לְחֻמֵי Deut 32:24 ; eat (mostly Proverbs), absolute Prov 23:1 ; followed by accusative of congnate meaning with verb לֶחֶם 4:17 ; 23:6 ; followed by בְּלַחְמִי 9:5 ; followed by בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶם Psa 141:4 eat of their dainties ; רֶשֶׁף לְחֻמֵי Deut 32:24 (poem) eaten up with the Fire-bolt , figurative of pestilence (Dr).
